【原视频简介】
How does Snapple get its signature fruity taste into millions of bottles?

Get Chunky follows its own surprising production process, while Slice Soda combines flavor, sweetness, carbonation, and high-speed bottling to create a refreshing fizzy drink.

They look simple on store shelves, but behind each one is a carefully controlled manufacturing system.

So how are Snapple, Get Chunky, and Slice Soda actually made?

Let’s step inside and find out.
